actions.action: Wipe leaves top and underside with dilute dish soap solution
Rinse-wipe leaves with plain water and pat dry
Second cleaning pass in a few days for leftover specks
Mite check by tapping leaves over white paper every 4 days for 3 weeks
If mites found, wipe undersides with soap solution and rinse every 3 days for 2 weeks

reason: The answer correctly identifies the dust residue, and its soap-wipe-and-rinse method is harmless, but it uses dish soap instead of the acidic lemon-juice wipe that actually dissolved the residue, so it is only partly the same fix.
